content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a challenge from the challenger's own footed chain by citing the disputed sentence's own wording instead of weighing chain against chain by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"by footing, never verse by verse: (1) weigh the challenger chain against the defender chain as wholes by support/footing; (2) allow a disputed verse's own wording to decide against the chain.","why":"By making the sentence's own words decisive after acknowledging the challenger's analogy is footed, it uses the retired stating-verse test and does not weigh chain against chain by footing."}
